reviews.title: Great hassle free and convenient system!
reviews.comment: The new corsair link system, is hassle free and it was exactly what I was needing! I had so many issues with so many cables (having 9 fans) trying to have them connected in the most clean way, but unfortunately I was never successful. The software runs well and I haven't had any issues so far. Thank you corsair!

reviews.title: Look Great and Easy to Use
reviews.comment:
I love the Icue Link fan and the LX and LX-R fans look great in any PC. 

Absolute no brainer if you already are in the Corsair or Icue Link ecosystem. 

Keep in mind Icue Link Hub requires a PCIe power connection. Make sure you have an open spot on your PSU. SATA will not power these fans.
